title: ないことはない
meaning: it isn't the case that 〜 not 〜; it is not that 〜 not 〜
meaning_example: It's not that I don't read newspapers, but very rarely do I read them.

comments.text: The difference between 食べないこともない and 食べられないこともない is that the former is subjective and the latter is objective. 食べられない=it is normally not fit to eat. 食べられないこともない=it is not that [it is normally not fit to eat]. 食べない=The speaker does not eat. 食べないこともない=it is not that [speaker does not eat].
